Phase 0 Live

Foundation

The core AFWE engine.

  • Core architecture

  • Local documentation
  • Cross-platform support

Phase 1 Live

Studio

Understand your codebase.

  • Visual Codebase Atlas

Phase 2 Live

Governance

Keep your architecture intact.

  • Constraints as geometry
  • Turn system (begin to commit)
  • Intent verification
  • Tripwires & BLAKE3
  • Probing guides & rubric
View details
Phase 3 Live

Ecosystem

Extend AFWE everywhere.

  • All 57 MCP tools
  • Editor integrations
  • CI & automation
  • API & SDK architecture
  • Community contributions
View details
Phase 4 In Progress

Community

Sustain and grow AFWE.

  • Sustainer recognition
  • Seat pool system

  • Roadmap voting
  • Open support knowledge

Phase 5+ Planned

Beyond

A bigger AFWE.

  • Advanced analytics

  • Deeper integrations
  • Global community hub
  • Long-term ecosystem
